The Road Code · Daily Lesson

Win In That Wind.

November 12, 2026 · Richmond Hill, Georgia · Day 1,290 · 66,677.0 documented miles — this tour.

Win In That Wind — the film, 3:25

Day 1,290, he rolled out of Hardeeville pointed at Richmond Hill, and the wind was already standing in the road. Before the day was old, he said it out loud: “I’m not going to let the wind define me — I’m going to win in that wind.”

Headwind all day — a pine corridor first, then the marsh on the Savannah side, trucks throwing weather every time they passed. By the Henderson stop, 32.2 miles were banked, and he was still coming: “No brakes, man. Never. No stopping. No brakes.”

Win In That Wind — the sizzle cut, 1:27

Then the road ran out, the live oaks closed over it, and the wind got its answer — the arrival chant, verbatim: “I’m not done! I’m not done yet! I earned it! I’m worthy! You and me, baby! I give you everything I got!”

The lesson — THE DISCIPLINE: Don’t wait for the wind to quit. Win in it. The wind doesn’t get a vote; it stood in the road all day, and the day got ridden anyway.

R.O.D.A. — Ride Out, Defy Anything.
